column1: # Plain-English glosses appended to a command before it is embedded, so a question like
# "undo my last commit but keep the changes" can meet "git reset --soft HEAD~1".
# Format: <regex, case-insensitive, matched anywhere in the masked command><TAB><phrase>. Every matching line applies.
# Keep phrases in the words people use when they ask, not in the tool's own vocabulary.
